ulasan.Ulasan: Adorable shop with very reasonable prices.  I bought 3 things and they totaled under 20 dollars.  I had so much fun looking at the items from Gramma's house and very clever and well-done local crafts! I will definitely stop in again.  Shhhh, I got my Mom a Christmas present too!

ulasan.Ulasan: Great mix of antiques, and handcrafted treasures and vintage goods at reasonable prices. Friendly talented  owner's. We just stopped by  for the first time since covid started and it was like being with old friends.  Definitely stop by here . It's worth the trip! 😇❣️.                  Stopped by again  yesterday for a visit. So good to see Deb. As usual we found lots of good treasures. Deb has been busy felting and has lots of great felted gnomes and other wonderful critters. She always remembers us and even puts aside things she knows that we collect and saves them for us!  They are now open year-round It's absolutely worth the stop.

ulasan.Ulasan: Wonderful shop filled with all manner of antiques, collectibles, and exquisite hand made items. Hand made items include signs and other decor, blacksmithed items (hooks, etc.), and beautiful felted items. The owners, Deb & John, are wonderful people. Located right on the Mohawk Trail (Route 2) always worth a stop!
